system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: layer-wise skill files for the layers spanned by the repair crop
system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; the agent input is assembled from DRM images, the crop script, the DRV distribution and the evolving per-layer skill files.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: the repair crop represented by a KLayout Python script, (iii) its DRV distribution
env_context_strategy.note: The crop layout is injected up front and the agent also uses preview tools. Crop injection does not fit any enum value exactly.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no config or loop code is available.

observation_format.evidence_quote: design rule manual (DRM) images, (ii) the repair crop represented by a KLayout Python script
observation_format.note: DRM images are inputs rather than tool observations. The formats of tool results are not specified.

tool_call_format.note: Repair operations are shown as JSON. The syntax used to call the preview tools is not reported.

tool_count.evidence_quote: three preview tools in Table 2 are provided to each repair agent
tool_count.note: The layout edit operations in Table 1 (12) are returned as an operation list, not called as tools.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: Table 1 defines the available operations for each class of object.
edit_primitive.note: Edits are structural geometry operations (move_via, resize, etc.), not text edits. ast_aware is the closest value; this is an ambiguity.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The agents adopt the ReAct paradigm [2] to reason and act on DRC repair.
loop_primitives.note: There is an outer 3-stage iteration pipeline. Conflicting via edits are tested individually and the best one is selected.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: internally executes the four-role workflow: a planner, an adversarial plan reviewer, a DRC engineer, and a patch reviewer

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: decomposes large layouts into bounded repair crops and dispatches one repair agent per crop
multi_agent_topology.note: The orchestrator is a script, not an agent. Skill Refiner, DB Summarizer and Skill Judge form a later stage.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: dispatches one repair agent per crop

short_term_state.evidence_quote: EvoDRC discards all intermediate trial records and only allows each repair agent to return its final verdict

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: the Skill directory stores the skill file for each metal layer
long_term_memory.note: The Knowledge DB stores operation–result history per layer.

self_verification.evidence_quote: EvoDRC accepts a repair agent’s final repair operation list only when it passes the full-design connectivity check.
self_verification.note: Harness DRC and connectivity checks function as tests. The Skill Judge judges skill files; a patch reviewer role also exists.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: We allow EvoDRC to run for at most five iterations and stop early when the block reaches zero violations.

rollback.note: Paper only. Edits are applied to a copy for checks, but no rollback is described.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: a repair task completes when the agent submits its final repair operation list
termination_condition.note: The outer loop is capped at 5 iterations and stops early at zero DRVs.

cost_controls.note: Cache pricing is mentioned, but no cost mechanism is described.

timeouts.evidence_quote: There’s no runtime limitation for agents to repair DRC

execution_isolation.note: Local DRC is described as running in a sandbox, but the agent execution boundary is not reported.

permission_model.evidence_quote: These classes distinguish editable objects from frozen context

tracing.evidence_quote: Repair operations and their resulting DRV changes are stored in a knowledge database

replayability.evidence_quote: The geometry of repair crops is also stored in the Knowledge DB for future replay purposes.

guardrails.evidence_quote: verify whether the proposed repair operation breaks net connectivity, which affects circuit logic, so such operations are forbidden

target_domain.evidence_quote: a skill-evolution framework for agentic block-level DRC repair

open_source.note: The paper says 'EvoDRC is available at [13]', but the licence is unknown.

model_agnostic.note: Only Claude Sonnet 4.6 is used; no abstraction is described.

primary_artifact.note: No repo is in the evidence bundle.

first_release_date.note: Paper v1 date is used as the fallback.
